projects.title: FinBot
projects.description:
Finbot is a stock and crypto trade simulation bot for discord.

Made just for fun with friends. No official hosting yet. Feel free to run your own.

projects.title: Parallel
projects.description: Parallel is a 2D PC game. The game was made for my CSE380 Computer Game Programming course. The game is made with C++, using DirectX 9 for rendering, Box2D for physics and LuaPlus for scripting of AI.
